description: Mindomo helps users find, view, create, edit, theme, export, and manage mind maps and smart diagram templates from ChatGPT. Diagram preview tools can render an inline ChatGPT widget that fetches and mounts Mindomo's read-only viewer directly in the widget document, while the server enforces account permissions, plan gates, rate limits, and per-tool scopes.

defaultPrompt: Create a mind map showing how mind mapping turns ideas into clear, actionable plans.
Create a mind map of the key benefits of mind mapping for work, learning, and creativity.
Create a mind map showing how visual thinking improves clarity, memory, and decisions.
